## Regenerative Medicine Solutions

FDA-registered Class II PRP system engineered for precision and performance


APEX Biologix offers a comprehensive portfolio of FDA-registered Class II autologous biologic
systems, including Platelet-Rich Plasma (PRP), Protein Concentrate (A2M), and Bone Marrow
Concentrate (BMC). Engineered for precision, efficiency, and reproducibility, XCELL platforms are
designed to optimize biologic yield, streamline processing, and reduce variability while supporting
advanced regenerative medicine applications across orthopedics, sports medicine, interventional
pain, integrative care, and aesthetics.

## Welcome to Esco Lifesciences!
## A world-leading manufacturer and service provider of life science tools

Esco Lifesciences is a world-leading life science company with a diversified portfolio and sales in
over 100 countries. As a manufacturer of laboratory and biopharma equipment, and IVF medical
devices, Esco offers tailored solutions that fit the needs of laboratories in various industries.

Esco Lifesciences contributes to meet the challenges of the 21st century with a diverse range of
business units. The company continuously innovates its products to help the clinical and industrial
laboratories achieve successful conclusions in research and development, quality control, and
analysis. We continue to provide reliable world-class equipment to help pharmaceutical companies
make their products safer and more cost-effective. And with the increasing demand of the IVF
industry, we have developed efficient ART equipment to enable equitable access to infertility care.

business units. The company continuously innovates its products to help the clinical and industrial
laboratories achieve successful conclusions in research and development, quality control, and
analysis. We continue to provide reliable world-class equipment to help pharmaceutical companies
make their products safer and more cost-effective. And with the increasing demand of the IVF
industry, we have developed efficient ART equipment to enable equitable access to infertility care.

We are living in the bio-century. Global medical knowledge is expanding at a rapid pace. But despite
huge breakthroughs, many diseases, such as cancer, rheumatism or Alzheimer's, are still not
curable.  Sartorius is part of the solution.

We help to ensure that new scientific discoveries can be translated more quickly into effective
patient care. With technologies, platforms and partnerships for a common goal: better health for
more people.

### Aseptic Biopharmaceutical Processing

Aseptic bioprocessing is a method of manufacturing that produces foods and pharmaceuticals that are
free of bacteria without subjecting the final product to terminal sterilization.  Baker has
innovative solutions for a variety of bioprocessing workflows.
[Find out more About Aseptic Biopharmaceutical Processing][91]

### Cell Culture and Life Science Research

Understanding the benefits on creating ideal growth environments are creating exciting innovations
in how cell culture work is performed. Culture workflows are attempting to create stable and
continuous conditions. This creates less stress on cells and optimizes their growth potential.
[Find out more About Cell Culture and Life Science Research][92]

### Pharmaceutical Compounding

USP 797 and USP 800 provide the guidelines for compounding sterile preparations and the standards
for safe handling of hazardous drugs to minimize risk to healthcare personnel, patients, and the
environment. Baker is proud to provide support to pharmaceutical professionals to help them stay
current on the latest issues about aseptic preparation of parenteral drug products.
[Find out more About Pharmaceutical Compounding][93]

### Microbiology and Microbiome

Microbiological research plays a critical role in the development and safe production of drugs,
foods, beverages, and vaccines. This work helps stop the spread of viruses and diseases through
increased knowledge of how the microbes behave, their genetics, and how they are transmitted.
[Find out more About Microbiology and Microbiome][94]

### Biosafety and Contamination Control

Diverse applications in the life science, clinical, pharmaceutical, and industrial laboratory fields
must protect personnel, product, and the environment from exposure to biohazards and
cross-contamination. Since Baker developed the first clean air workstation in 1951, biosafety
cabinets have played a critical role in ensuring the safety of lab personnel and the integrity of
their work.
[Find out more About Biosafety and Contamination Control][90]

### Aseptic Biopharmaceutical Processing

Aseptic bioprocessing is a method of manufacturing that produces foods and pharmaceuticals that are
free of bacteria without subjecting the final product to terminal sterilization.  Baker has
innovative solutions for a variety of bioprocessing workflows.
[Find out more About Aseptic Biopharmaceutical Processing][91]

### Cell Culture and Life Science Research

Understanding the benefits on creating ideal growth environments are creating exciting innovations
in how cell culture work is performed. Culture workflows are attempting to create stable and
continuous conditions. This creates less stress on cells and optimizes their growth potential.
[Find out more About Cell Culture and Life Science Research][92]

### Pharmaceutical Compounding

USP 797 and USP 800 provide the guidelines for compounding sterile preparations and the standards
for safe handling of hazardous drugs to minimize risk to healthcare personnel, patients, and the
environment. Baker is proud to provide support to pharmaceutical professionals to help them stay
current on the latest issues about aseptic preparation of parenteral drug products.
[Find out more About Pharmaceutical Compounding][93]

### Microbiology and Microbiome

Microbiological research plays a critical role in the development and safe production of drugs,
foods, beverages, and vaccines. This work helps stop the spread of viruses and diseases through
increased knowledge of how the microbes behave, their genetics, and how they are transmitted.
[Find out more About Microbiology and Microbiome][94]

ERLAB FILTRATION

# Optimal protection for laboratories and enclosed environments.

**Since 1968, Erlab has been the world-leading specialist and inventor of standalone, ductless and
zero-emission filtering fume hoods, enabling chemicals to be handled safely in laboratories.** Since
day one, we have been entirely focused on researching, designing, developing and manufacturing
long-lasting protection solutions. Our primary objective is to provide our users with the most
effective solutions to protect them against chemical inhalation hazards in laboratories. Our
worldwide presence, production facilities and strong research and development activity enable us to
offer the most advanced filtration technology to laboratories in the chemical, pharmaceutical,
cosmetics and food industries, as well as to hospitals and educational institutions.

**industrial equipment**. Our focus is on **biological safety cabinets, fume cupboards, ultra-low
temperature freezers** and **isolator technology** and with over **50,000 **safety cabinets sold
**worldwide **, we set the standard for quality and innovation.

Our product range also includes **laminar flow systems**, **laboratory furniture** and **customised
solutions** that meet the highest safety and quality standards. With our technical expertise and
many years of experience, we serve the needs of our customers in areas such as microbiology,
chemistry, pharmacy, biotechnology, diagnostics, veterinary medicine and industry.

# Laboratory Equipment Manufacturer for Research & Testing

][27]

Labtron Equipment is a leading manufacturer of innovative Laboratory Equipment and Analytical
Equipment for all kinds of laboratory applications. Our laboratory equipment are compact,
energy-efficient, and durable, featuring built-in safety for versatile use. We offer a range of
laboratory equipment and analytical instruments including centrifuges, chillers, incubators, mixers,
freeze dryers, shakers, petroleum testing, water testing, airborne particle counters, biochemistry
analyzers, test chambers, automated stainers, furnaces, GC-MS, HPLC, spectrophotometers, and more,
ensuring comprehensive support for all your laboratory needs. We make sure every product meets our
high standards by carefully checking them with strict quality control measures.

We are ISO 9001:2015 Certified company and all our products comply with stringent International
Standards such as Certificate of Compliance (2014/35/EU Low Voltage Directive & 2014/32/EU Measuring
Instruments Directive), Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) System, ISO 13485:2016, ISO 9001:2015, EC
Declaration of Conformity (In Vitro Diagnostic Medical Devices Directive 98/79/EC) and Certificate
of Conformity (European Pressure Equipment Directive 2014/68/EU).

We can also provide IQ, OQ, and PQ Certifications with our products.

## Established in 1980

and excellence, Newtronic has consistently delivered high-quality, reliable, and cutting-edge
solutions to meet the evolving needs of the industry. Newtronic trusted by professionals worldwide,
we are dedicated to maintaining the highest standards of safety, precision, and efficiency, ensuring
our clients achieve optimal performance in their critical operations.

[Know More][93]
Our Cutting Edge

## Technology

Ethernet Communication

Offers high-speed data transfer, surpassing serial (RS-485) communication, and adheres to a global
standard for communication protocol, enabling data operations from any PC over the LAN without
requiring a separate PC interface.

2nd Generation I-Series Controllers

With no data loss, the PLC stores up to 1000 readings, allowing data storage for up to 20 days with
readings taken at 30-minute intervals.

Touch Screen Display

The system features both password-based and biometric access control, effectively restricting access
to unauthorized persons.

Complete Range Of Alarms

The system monitors temperature and humidity deviations, door openings, water supply failures,
component failures, and mains failures.

Alarm Transmissions

Alarm transmissions are sent to the software, remote locations such as a security gate, through
detailed SMS notifications, and locally at the equipment with audio-visual indications and on the
display.

Humidity System

The humidity system utilizes non-condensing steam injection for reach-ins and small capacity
walk-ins, and operates on the principles of dew point control for walk-ins.

standard for communication protocol, enabling data operations from any PC over the LAN without
requiring a separate PC interface.

2nd Generation I-Series Controllers

With no data loss, the PLC stores up to 1000 readings, allowing data storage for up to 20 days with
readings taken at 30-minute intervals.

Touch Screen Display

The system features both password-based and biometric access control, effectively restricting access
to unauthorized persons.

Complete Range Of Alarms

The system monitors temperature and humidity deviations, door openings, water supply failures,
component failures, and mains failures.

Alarm Transmissions

Alarm transmissions are sent to the software, remote locations such as a security gate, through
detailed SMS notifications, and locally at the equipment with audio-visual indications and on the
display.

Humidity System

The humidity system utilizes non-condensing steam injection for reach-ins and small capacity
walk-ins, and operates on the principles of dew point control for walk-ins.

### WE build legacies, not commodities

We have "learned our trade" in the industry ever since our company founding in 1971. NuAire has
maintained its commitment to offer its customers the best containment for the best long term value
rather than follow the tendency of some to transform the cabinet into a cheap commodity.


### we configure for your application

Our engineering-driven philosophy believes that our most important differentiator is a design that
is fully wrapped around your needs. From control systems, to access heights, to custom products, we
offer the maximum choice in configuration while building on a safe and reliable foundation.


### we value your CUSTOMER experience

We don't believe in "sell and forget." From one of the industry's most comprehensive warranties on
biosafety cabinets to a service department that answers your phone call live, we offer the best long
term customer experience possible to ensure your investment in us pays dividends for decades.

providing personnel, product, and environmental protection in critical research environments
throughout the world.

professionals with quality laboratory equipment.

## Welcome to *Smart Labtech*

Smart Labtech with its long standing operations in scientific community emerges as manufacturer and
supplier of quality and time tested products in Quality Control, R&D laboratories with “Make in
India” concept as the main drive. Products are completely of made-in-house spectrum with some of
them being OEM made.

Smart Labtech is committed to deliver reliable products with  best-in-class technology and user
friendly features. The company takes pride in providing comprehensive and responsible support and
assistance to every customer. Smart Labtech is ISO 9001-2015 certified and is catering to various
segments of customers pan India.

Head quartered at Hyderabad, India, Smart Labtech has good sales and distribution network covering
India for last two decades. This trust and confidence has enabled Smart Labtech to enter its
activities into the manufacturing arena. The effective service that is offered to our customers made
this company  a trusted  and reliable  technical solution provider with a strong bonding with our
customers.  

###### Our Journey Over The Years

## Smart *Labtech*

We started our journey in 2001 and have come out successfully with our uncompromising quality
products and services right from the day of its inception.  We pace up with latest technologies and
go with the trend in every aspect keeping our vision and mission intact at every phase of
action.  We owe to continue with our stern policy to meet the specific requirements of  our clients
with our products and services.

## Why Choose Us

### Application Lab

The newly expanded and redesigned, staffed with a team of experts, here is the place where we make
ideas happen.

### Experience

Our Service Engineers are well experienced and factory-trained to offer efficient after-sales
services.

### Presence

Through our Regional Offices and Resident Offices our professional service engineers are available
pan India.

### Best Price

We provide comprehensive and non-comprehensive Annual Maintenance Contracts with nominal service
charges.

## About Us

[Vision][8]
Through sharp focus on innovation, great design and market leading customer service, SMART LABTECH
has witnessed substantial growth and brand acknowledgement in recent years. We believe that at a
passionate approach to every project – paired with high team spirit amongst our competent employees
enables us to make a significant difference for all of our customers.
[Mission][9]
Our mission is to transform our commitment to the pursuit of knowledge into the ability to develop
innovative “Customer Oriented” solutions. To design and create increasingly new solutions whilst
continuing to renew existing products was our key to success. For more than 20 years, SMART LABTECH
has focused on innovation in its products range and production processes, constantly improving its
development capacity to provide the best service and support for its clients.
[Values][10]
Through dedicated and ambitious teamwork, SMART LABTECH takes pride in providing value added
solutions – all the way from the early stages of design right down to delivery according to market
and customer needs all around the globe.

## Internet de las cosas Soluciones en la nube

[

### Soluciones de red de sangre

IoT Gestión inteligente de la seguridad de la sangre proporciona una plataforma sistematizada segura
y unificada para el suministro de sangre de toda la ciudad. 

Leer más
][74] [

### Soluciones de red de laboratorio

Haier Biomédica proporciona soluciones de protección para operadores, muestras y el medio ambiente.
Desde la evaluación del sitio y la planificación del diseño antes de la construcción del laboratorio
hasta el diseño de infraestructura estandarizado, apoyar gabinetes de seguridad biológica, bancos
limpios, refrigeradores sin chispas y otras soluciones de productos durante la construcción del
laboratorio. 

Leer más
][75] [

### Soluciones de red de vacunas

Desde vacunas problemáticas, vacunas expiradas hasta vacunas mal escritas, varios tipos de
incidentes de vacunas han expuesto problemas como la falta de vacunación inteligente y la regulación
de vacunas no científicas y no reguladas, que han afectado gravemente la salud de los niños y se han
convertido en un foco común de la sociedad.

Leer más
][76] [

### Soluciones de red de reactivos

Basado en la aplicación de la tecnología IoT inteligente en productos médicos refrigerados, Haier
Biomédica realiza un seguimiento de la información en tiempo real de cada término en el
almacenamiento y una gestión completa automática e inteligente de reactivos y medicamentos



Leer más
][77] [

### Soluciones de red de muestra

En el área de los biobancos, Haier Biomédica realiza la interacción tripartita en tiempo real de
humanos, máquinas y muestras por la combinación del almacenamiento criogénico y el sistema de
gestión de IoT. Nuestras soluciones no solo pueden monitorear y controlar de manera efectiva la
temperatura de las muestras y el estado operativo de los equipos, sino que también cumplen con los
requisitos de los usuarios para el posicionamiento preciso de las muestras, la verificación y la
disposición rápida, lo que mejora en gran medida la precisión y la eficiencia de la gestión de
muestras biológicas y pone en marcha la revolución de la gestión de muestras.  
Leer más
][78]

Stericox is the oldest laboratory equipment manufacturing company in India. Existence since 1978,
the company was known for autoclave and sterilizers. As the time passed, the company started
manufacturing of other laboratory equipment and today we are manufacturing wide range of equipment
and machines used in pharmaceutical, hospitals, laboratory research, textile, electrolyte testing
and light industrial applications etc.

Forty years on, the company enjoys a significant market share, from original customers to dealers,
we have long years of faithful business relationship. Our business is built on philosophy of hard
work, professional service, friendly advice, high standard of equipment and honest pricing policy.

With Stericox you can equip your laboratory with high quality Indian make laboratory equipment that
offer accurate test results, simple operation and long working life. If you would like to set up new
laboratory or intend to buy new equipment, please browse our website and find out our list of
laboratory equipment we manufacture. Each equipment is made carefully and supplied with economical
price guarantee, excellent warrantee service and reliable after sales repair and maintenance
support.

With Stericox you get:
* Over 50 products to choose
* Customized laboratory equipment
* Supply with installation and training
* Export to Africa and Middle East countries

Stericox is the oldest laboratory equipment manufacturing company in India. Existence since 1978,
the company was known for autoclave and sterilizers. As the time passed, the company started
manufacturing of other laboratory equipment and today we are manufacturing wide range of equipment
and machines used in pharmaceutical, hospitals, laboratory research, textile, electrolyte testing
and light industrial applications etc.

Forty years on, the company enjoys a significant market share, from original customers to dealers,
we have long years of faithful business relationship. Our business is built on philosophy of hard
work, professional service, friendly advice, high standard of equipment and honest pricing policy.

With Stericox you can equip your laboratory with high quality Indian make laboratory equipment that
offer accurate test results, simple operation and long working life. If you would like to set up new
laboratory or intend to buy new equipment, please browse our website and find out our list of
laboratory equipment we manufacture. Each equipment is made carefully and supplied with economical
price guarantee, excellent warrantee service and reliable after sales repair and maintenance
support.

With Stericox you get:
* Over 50 products to choose
* Customized laboratory equipment
* Supply with installation and training
* Export to Africa and Middle East countries

## Why Choose Us?

### Quality Assurance

Our cleanroom air filters and equipment are designed and manufactured to the highest industry
standards. We use the best materials and the latest technology to ensure that our products meet your
needs and exceed your expectations.

### Since 2012

We've been in business since 2012, and we're proud of our reputation in the industry. We've earned
the trust of our customers through our commitment to quality and service.

### Customization

We understand that every cleanroom is different, which is why we offer custom solutions. Our team
will work with you to design and manufacture cleanroom air filters and equipment that meet your
specific needs.
